## Episode Thesis

This episode is a political debate before the Swedish election between Finance Minister Elisabeth Svantesson (M) and Mikael Damberg (S), the Social Democrats' economic policy spokesperson. It covers Sweden's economic recovery (Q2 GDP +1.6%, 8.7% unemployment, low inflation), borrowing and the budget framework, tax policy (a proposed billionaire tax, a possible bank tax, the sick-day deduction, an R&D super-deduction, ISK) and Trump's economic policy. Very few companies come up, and nobody gives a view on any stock. The only sector theme is Damberg's criticism of weak competition and very large profits in Swedish banking, plus the threat of a bank tax, which is a political risk for listed banks.
